summary: Execute GitHub issue lists sequentially through Koru

delivery.outcome: Execute a finite snapshot of open GitHub issues sequentially from an issues-list URL, preserving scoped single-issue verification, Planfile reporting and protected publication.
nonGoals: No concurrent issue execution or automatic widening of operator profiles
No live hardware effects or automatic execution of real C2004 issues during tests
No branch or PR in C2004; no direct merge in governed repositories

architecture.decision: Freeze paginated open-issue identities, exclude PRs, and reuse run_ticket for every sequential effect. Stop on failed or incomplete delivery. Operator profiles and per-issue receipts remain authoritative; add a repository execution lock to prevent concurrent writers. Persist the finite queue selection in ignored repository-local working data so closed issues with unfinished reporting are not lost during restart.
architecture.rollback: Revert material implementation; retain existing issue receipts and working data.

validation.evidence: Focused tests, read-only list preview and protected exact-head delivery receipts
